GOMBE NATIONAL PARK TANZANIA
"Close-up of moss-covered rocks with plants sprouting from crevices."
With words and narration by Jane Goodall
"A large tree stands in the forest, surrounded by dense foliage. A stream flows nearby, reflecting sunlight, while a butterfly rests on fallen leaves."
"A large tree with sprawling branches and dense green leaves fills the frame, viewed from below, with sunlight filtering through the canopy."
"A vast forested hillside under a partly cloudy sky transitions to leaves and branches of a tree with small flying insects, followed by a chimpanzee moving through the foliage."
"A chimpanzee atop a tree, surrounded by green leaves, raises its arms wide. The camera shifts to a close-up of the chimpanzee's face, looking directly at the viewer with its mouth slightly open."
"A chimpanzee mother sits on the forest floor with her baby beside her; she opens her mouth, perhaps vocalizing or yawning, as another chimpanzee climbs a nearby tree."
"A baboon navigates a dense forest, eyes darting. The camera pans up to towering tree branches, then shows a yellow insect on a leaf."
"A green snake slithers across a mossy tree branch, while water cascades down a nearby rocky waterfall surrounded by lush greenery."
"Rolling hills, lush greenery, water reflecting sunlight, birds soaring, dense foliage, chimpanzee gripping branch."
"Close-up of two baboons touching faces, a fluffy insect on a green leaf, a bird soaring over palm trees, and the calm ocean under clouds."
"Aerial view of a coastline with lush green hills and mountains, transitioning to a dense forest with tall trees and sunlight filtering through the canopy."
